## Summary

- **Font URL typo** (`+layout.svelte:31`): `&vamily=` → `&family=` in the Google Fonts URL. Bricolage Grotesque was never loading; the body font silently fell back to Avenir Next / Segoe UI.
- **Dead `|| 502` guard** (`generate-pipeline.ts:106`): `Response.status` is always a valid HTTP status code for a resolved fetch; the `|| 502` fallback is unreachable dead code that implies a misunderstanding of the Fetch API.
- **Redundant double-parse + dead catch** (`chat-interpretation-pipeline.ts`): `extractSingleJsonObject` validated the JSON internally but returned the raw string, causing the caller to re-parse it with a try/catch that could never fire. Refactored to return the parsed object directly.
- **Unused `response` in `postJson`** (`http-client.ts` + 11 call sites): Every caller destructured only `{ payload }` and ignored `response`. Simplified the return type to `Promise<unknown>` and removed the dead wrapper across all call sites.

## Test plan

- [ ] All 381 existing unit/contract tests pass (`npm run test`)
- [ ] TypeScript check passes (`npm run check`)
- [ ] Verify Bricolage Grotesque font loads in the browser (body text should render in the correct custom font)
- [ ] Confirm generation, tools, and wig try-on flows still work end-to-end

## Summary by Sourcery

Fix multiple small issues across the chat/generation pipelines, HTTP client, UI pages, and layout to simplify JSON handling, remove dead code, and correct the font configuration.

Bug Fixes:
- Correct the Google Fonts URL so the Bricolage Grotesque font loads properly.
- Return the actual HTTP image response status without an unreachable fallback status code.
- Avoid redundant JSON parsing in the chat interpretation pipeline by operating on a single parsed object.

Enhancements:
- Simplify the postJson helper to return only the parsed payload and update all callers accordingly.

Tests:
- Adjust the HTTP client unit test to reflect the simplified postJson return value.
